post.description:
Claude writes one read-only SQL query for the question, the API validates and runs it,
and Claude explains the rows. Numbers in the answer come from the rows, never the model.

503.description: Ask is off or cannot run: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (code llm_not_configured), no reader role password (reader_not_configured), the model or database cannot be reached (llm_unavailable, reader_unavailable) or no data is loaded (no_data).

schema.title: Response Ask Tables Ask Tables Get

post.description:
Translate a what-if case ("What if Johan Sverdrup stops for two months and oil goes to
$90?") into scenario parameters.

Claude only reports what the text says; every number is computed here from the marts and the
reference levels you send, range-checked and explained in `assumptions`. Snake_case on
purpose: this is the scenario model's parameter contract.

422.description: The text could not be turned into scenario parameters

get.description:
36 months of p10 / p50 / p90 (Sm³ o.e. per month) and the model card.

The first point repeats the last actual month so a chart line continues from history.
Shut-down fields return their model card with no points.
Newest live prediction per focus company, for the latest quarter predicted (kboe/d).
The prediction log: every live and backtest prediction, actuals, errors and hashes.
